# Platform (`platform`)

The robot itself: speed limits, payload, power.

Groups are in bold; leaves (ODD parameters) are in code font with type, unit, physical bounds and nominal distribution.

- `max_speed` (continuous; m/s; [0, 5]): Speed limit configured on the robot base. Aliases: speed limit, top speed, velocity limit.
- `payload_mass` (continuous; kg; [0, 500]): Mass of the load the robot carries or manipulates. Aliases: payload, load, carried weight, object mass.
- `battery_level` (continuous; [0, 1]): Battery state of charge. Aliases: state of charge, battery, charge level, low battery.
